key_entities: Streaming validation (use when Discovery is sharded)
propositions: The rebar-janitor packaged skill discovery phase had only eight concerns and lacked coverage for unwired or partially wired functionality (values accepted but silently dropped), which was the highest-yield finding class in the 2026-08-05/06 run.

Two discovery concerns (comment quality and test-suite health) are oversized for single-subagent review, and the skill provided no sharding or streaming-validation guidance, causing runs to either batch unreviewable pools or skip concerns on volume grounds.
The skill's verification phase had no guidance for validating a sharded discovery stream.

Three Markdown files in the skill must be updated with three new discovery concerns (9, 10, 11), a new streaming-validation section in verification.md, and operating principles about sharding and not skipping concerns due to volume.
